title: Mujhe Le Chalo Baba
body:
Daaman Pakad Ke Kehti Hai, Baba Kab Aaoge
Le Jaawo Hame Ke, Yahin Chod Jaaoge
Bimaar Ki Khabar Bhi, Kisi Se Mangaoge
Ya Pyaar Main Sakina Ke, Hum Ko Bhulaaoge
Bachpan Tab Bhi Aur Ye Ghazab Ki Judaai Bhi
Maa Baap Bhi Bichadte Hain, Behne Bhi Bhai Bhi
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba
Jaane Lage Shabbir To Kehne Lagi Sughra
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba(2x)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Bimaar Pe Tanhaayi Ka Khanjar Na
Chalaao,
Kyun Nazre Churate Ho Tumhe Jaana Hai Jaao,
Ik Baat Meri Maan Lo Ache Mere Baba
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jati Hai Kanize Bhi Kanizo'n Hi Main Rakhlo,
Kab Maine Kaha Hai Mujhe Naaqe Main Bithaao,
Paidal Hi Safar Hoga Mera Karbobala Ka
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba...
3.Waada Hai Ke Zehmat Na Safar Main Koi Dungi,
Main Balon Se Saya Ali Asghar Ka Karungi,
Rehne Nahi Dungi Main Tumhe Raah Main Pyasa
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Main Paani Pulaungi Tere Naaqe Ko Baba,
Main Pusht Pe Rakhungi Sada Mashke Sakina,
Beshak Kare Aaram Safar Main Teri Fizza
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Akbar Ki Ziyarat Kiye Jaaungi Har Dam,
Didar Hai Akbar Ka Mere Zakhmo Ka Marham,
Marne Se Bachalo Mujhe Chodo Nahi Tanha
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba ...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Akbar Jo Chale Jaayenge Main Kaise Jiyungi,
Furqat Ki Aziyat Bhala Kaise Sahungi,
Marjaaegi Marjaaegi Marjaaegi Sughra
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba....
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Samjhane Lage Beti Ko Yun Hazrate Shabbir,
Sughrah Main Maqtal Main Liye Jate Hai Taqdeer,
Ye Kehke Sadae(n) Phat Ta Hai Kaleja
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Bimaar Ho Garmi Ki Aziyat Na Sahungi,
Tum Raahe Musibat Se Safar Kaise Karungi,
Honaae Shifa Khair Se Tab Khat Mujhe Likhna
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Nani Ki Hifazat Main Diye Jaata Hu Timko,
Amma Ki Lahad Dekh Ke Socha Karo Humko,
Ab Zid Na Karo Jaao Ye Kehna Na Khudaara
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Phir Sura E Yasin Padne Lage Maula,
Beti Ko Dua Deke Pukaare Shahe-E-Waala,
Marjaaunga Ab Gham Se Agar Tumne Pukara
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba..
Jaane Lage Shabbir To Kehne Lagi Sughra,
Mujhe Le Chalo Baba(2x)
============================
